claims: The Seattle Mariners opened their 2026 season on Thursday, March 26, at T-Mobile Park against the Cleveland Guardians.
The Seattle Mariners lost 6-4 to the Cleveland Guardians.
Dominic Canzone hit two home runs.
Brendan Donovan hit a home run.
Luke Raley hit a home run.
A seventh-inning RBI double from Jose Ramírez secured the win for Cleveland.
The final score was Guardians 6, Mariners 4.
The Guardians took the lead in the top of the seventh inning on a two-run double by José Ramírez.
The Mariners unveiled their 2025 AL West Championship banner before the game.
The opening series features a Julio Rodríguez "No Fly Zone" Bobblehead Night on April 1–3.
